sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Antoehr
Counsel for Applicant :- Sita Devi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Gajendra Kumar,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State- opposite party and perused
the record.

2.  This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to modify the bail order dated 09.08.2021 passed by Sh. Amar Singh, Ld. ASJ (POCSO-2) Mathura in case FIR No.622/2021, PS Vrindavan, U/s 376, 377, 506 IPC to the extent of deleting the para 7 of the order which reads as "That the accused will not leave the territory of this Hon'ble Court without the permission of the Hon'ble Court/ The Investigating Officer".
3. Submission of learned counsel for the applicant is that applicant is permanent resident of Banda,
Uttar Pradesh.

That it is further submitted that the applicant is an aspiring lecturer and the work profile of the petitioner is of the nature that it would require/ requires frequent travelling for the want of participation for delivering lectures, attending conferences/ seminars and/ or appearing for examination at various States or for interviews in liew of job opportunities across the country.

It is also pertinent to mention that the petitioner's mother is suffering from severe depression and other Ashish Shukla vs State Of U.P. And Antoehr on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116241188/
1 ailments and the applicant is to look after her as there is no one else in the family to look after her.
Submission is that the applicant has to attend her and travel to Banda regularly.

entities.text: other Ashish Shukla vs State Of U.P. And Antoehr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Further submission is that condition no.7 of bail order dated 09.08.2021 restricting his movement is hurting his better employment opportunities and learning, performing social and family obligation and responsibilities.
A prayer on behalf of applicant is made to partially modify the order dated 9.8.2021 passed by the court below to the extent of relaxing and deleting the condition no.7 of the order.

4. In view of the facts and circumstances of the case, the condition no.7 of the order dated 9.8.2021,
to the effect that accused will not leave the jurisdiction of the court without permission of the Police Station/ Court, is apparently rigorous which needs to be substituted to the effect that accused will not leave the jurisdiction of the court without prior intimation to the court.
5. With the aforesaid directions, this application stands disposed of.
